key_result: Acceptance requires positive net edge after costs, a positive bootstrap lower bound, survival at higher costs and per-year stability, with a holdout that can be opened once.
takeaway: Describes an open-source research loop in which a language model proposes strategy changes as fixed-vocabulary JSON and only trusted code evaluates them.
title: Hard to Fool: A Bounded LLM Research Loop for Quantitative Finance, and What Two Dozen Campaigns Found
why_it_matters: Agentic loops that keep whatever improves a backtest manufacture false discoveries; this one is built to refuse them.
